source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.6, stellar evolution (PDF 12-15).

blocks.text: Jab kinetic theory of gases ko sitaron (stars) aur galaxies jaise falakiyati (astrophysical) systems par lagaya jaye to yeh galaxy mein sitaron ke irtiqa (evolution, waqt ke saath badalna) aur sitare ke atmosphere ke gas atoms ko samajhne mein madad deti hai.

Stellar evolution yeh parhta hai ke sitara waqt ke saath kaise badalta hai. Sitaron ki umar chand million saal se le kar trillions saal tak hoti hai, aur sitare ki umar us ke mass par munhasir hai. Sab se kam mass wale sitaron (red dwarfs) ki umar sab se lambi hai, kainat ki maujooda umar se bhi zyada. Tamam sitare gas aur gard (dust) ke badalon se bante hain jinhein nebulae ya molecular clouds kehte hain; sukarta hua badal proto-star kehlata hai. Badal sukarta hai to particles ki K.E. barhti hai, is liye density aur temperature barhte hain (K.E. ∝ T). Millions saal baad proto-star tawazun (equilibrium) hasil kar ke sitara ban jata hai. Density barhne se sitare ki gases ki rms velocity barhti hai, is se average kinetic energy aur aakhir temperature waqt ke saath barhta hai. Figure 13.4 gravity aur pressure ka muqabla dikhati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke 'sab se bhari sitaron ki umar lambi hoti hai'. Haqeeqat ulat hai: bhari sitare apna eendhan bohat tezi se jalate aur sirf chand million saal jeete hain, jab ke sab se halke sitare (red dwarfs) trillion saal, kainat ki maujooda umar se bhi zyada, jeete hain. Kitab khud aage chal kar red dwarfs ke bare mein yahi kehti hai.

blocks.alt: Teen gole. Baen: gole ke andar gulabi teer (self-gravity) andar ki taraf aur bahar neele teer (gas pressure) bahar ki taraf. Beech aur daen: gas ka badal jis ke chaaron taraf aik gulabi gravity teer andar aur aik neela pressure teer bahar hai; daen badal ke zarrat beech wale se kahin zyada qareeb qareeb hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.4: Kashish-e-saql (gravity) ka dabao bahar ki taraf pressure se barabar hota hai. Zyada gravity gas ko daba kar ghana aur garam karti hai (kitab ki Figure 13.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Temperature barhne se andar ka pressure bhi barhta hai. Mustahkam (stable) sitara tab banta hai jab andar ki taraf kheenchne wali gravitational force bahar ki taraf dhakelne wale pressure ke bilkul barabar ho. Is shart ko hydrostatic equation bayan karti hai:
Yeh equation yaqeeni banati hai ke sitara na gravity se gir (collapse) jaye aur na be-hisaab phailta jaye.

Yahan P sitare ke andar pressure (unit area par force) hai, ΔP/Δr radius ke saath pressure badalne ki sharah (markaz se bahar ki taraf pressure kaise badalta hai), r sitare ke markaz se faasla, G gravitational constant (6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²), M_r radius r ke andar ka mass aur ρ_r radius r par density hai. Minus ka nishan batata hai ke pressure bahar ki taraf ghatta hai jab ke gravity andar kheenchti hai. Agar pressure aur gravity ka tawazun na rahe to do suratein hain:

items: Gravitational force > andar ka pressure: sitara sukarta (contract) hai aur garam hota hai.
Gravitational force < andar ka pressure: sitara phailta (expand) hai.

blocks.text: Jab sitare ke core (markaz) ka temperature barhta hai to nuclear fusion shuru hota hai: hydrogen ke nuclei jur kar helium banate hain. Is se bohat zyada energy nikalti hai jo sitare ko us ki zyada tar zindagi chalati hai. Musalsal energy banna sirf gravity se girne ke khilaf tawazun hi nahi rakhta, andar ka temperature bhi ahista ahista barhata hai; nateeja yeh ke sitara phailna shuru karta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Parsec faasle ki unit hai jo astronomers (falkiyat-dan) light-year ki jagah istemal karte hain, jaise miles ki jagah kilometres. Ek parsec taqreeban 3.26 light years, ya taqreeban 19 trillion miles (31 trillion km) hai.

Temperature mazeed barhne aur core ki banawat (composition) badalne se sitara bohat phail kar red giant ban sakta hai. Is marhale par jin sitaron ka mass kam az kam Sooraj ke aadhe mass ke barabar ho, un ke core mein helium fusion shuru ho sakta hai, jis se carbon aur oxygen jaise bhari elements bante hain. Zyada bhari sitaron mein yeh silsila marhala war aur bhari elements tak, iron tak, chalta hai.

Sitare ka aakhri anjam zyada tar us ke mass par munhasir hai. Nuclear fuel khatam hone par sitara gravity ke khilaf khud ko nahi sambhal sakta. Kam aur darmiyane mass wale sitaron ka core sukar kar ghana (dense) white dwarf banta hai aur bahar ki tahein (layers) khala mein phenk di jati hain, jo planetary nebula banati hain. Sooraj se taqreeban das guna zyada mass wale sitare zabardast supernova dhamake (explosion) se guzarte hain; is mein iron ka core gravity se gir kar neutron star ya black hole jaisi bohat ghani baqiyat (remnants) banata hai.

Red dwarf sitare kam mass aur fuel ke kifayati istemal ki wajah se bohat ahista badalte hain. Kainat abhi itni purani nahi ke koi red dwarf apni zindagi poori kar chuka ho. Theory ke models batate hain ke yeh sitare waqt ke saath ahista ahista zyada garam aur roshan honge, phir hydrogen fuel khatam kar ke kam mass wale white dwarfs ban jayenge.

blocks.alt: Shaakhon wala chart. Stellar nebula se ya to average star banta, phir red giant, planetary nebula aur white dwarf; ya massive star, phir red super giant aur supernova, jo aakhir mein neutron star ya black hole ban jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.5: Sitare ka zindagi ka chakkar (kitab ki Figure 13.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure mein massive star wale raaste par red super giant ke baad wale marhale ka naam 'Positron' chhapa hai. Yeh ghalti hai: yeh marhala supernova hai, aik bohat bara dhamaka (explosion), aur khaake mein yahi likha hai. Oopar wala raasta Sooraj jaise ausat sitaron ka hai, neeche wala bhari sitaron ka; bhari sitare ka aakhri anjam neutron star ya black hole hota hai.
Neutron stars

Neutron stars kainat ki sab se ghani (dense) maloom cheezon mein se hain, black holes ke baad doosre number par. Sab se qareeb wale bhi kai parsec door hain, is liye inhein seedha parhna mushkil hai. Bohat zyada density ki wajah se in ke andar ka maddah degenerate gas ki tarah bartao karta hai, aur in ki taqatwar gravity in ka model banana mushkil karti hai. NASA ke andaze ke mutabiq Milky Way galaxy mein ek arab (billion) tak neutron stars ho sakte hain. Ab tak dekhe gaye bohat se neutron stars nisbatan jawan hain, tezi se ghoomte hain aur radiation ki shuaein (beams) bhejte hain; inhein pulsars kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Neutron star jis ka aik hissa kaat kar andar dikhaya gaya hai. Markaz se bahar ki taraf safed teer par neutron degeneracy pressure likha hai, bahar se andar aata teer gravitational force hai, aur aik pointer bahar ki patli teh (thin atmosphere) dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.6: Neutron star ka qata (section) (kitab ki Figure 13.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Scientists ka khayal hai ke pulsar ki radiation tab banti hai jab taqatwar magnetic fields maddah ko neutron star ke magnetic poles ki taraf le jati hain. Jab sitara gir kar neutron star banta hai to sirf mass hi nahi dabta, magnetic field bhi bohat taqatwar ho jata hai: core girte waqt field lines ek doosre ke qareeb dab jati hain, aur qareeb lines ka matlab taqatwar field hai.
Hamara sitara (Sooraj)

Sooraj zameen ka sab se qareebi sitara aur hamare sayyare (planet) ke liye garmi aur roshni ka bara zariya hai. Yeh taqreeban 4.6 arab (billion) saal pehle gas aur gard ke ek bohat bare badal, solar nebula, se bana. Gravity se sukarne par markaz ka temperature barha aur protostar bana. Jab core bohat garam ho gaya to nuclear fusion shuru hua jis mein hydrogen helium mein badli aur bohat energy nikli. Sooraj ki zindagi ke marahil: nebula, protostar, main sequence, red giant, planetary nebula aur white dwarf. Is waqt Sooraj main sequence marhale mein hai, hydrogen ko helium mein badal kar garmi aur roshni bana raha hai. Thermal physics mein Sooraj is liye aham hai ke yeh bohat zyada heat energy ka qudrati zariya hai aur yeh energy zyada tar radiation ke zariye pohanchata hai.

blocks.alt: Timeline: Birth aur phir 1 se 14, arab saal (taqreeban) mein. Sooraj paidaish ke baad ahista ahista garam (gradual warming) hota aur barhta hai; 4 aur 5 ke darmiyan Now ka teer hai. Taqreeban 10 par red giant, 11 par planetary nebula aur 12 se 14 tak white dwarf. Size paimane par nahi.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.5: Sooraj ka zindagi ka chakkar (kitab ki Figure 13.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; kitab yeh number do dafa chhapti hai).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Neeche ke examples mein gravity ka pressure mota andaza Pg ≈ GM²/R⁴ se nikal kar sitare ke andar ke pressure se muqabla kiya gaya hai: Pg zyada ho to sitara sukarta hai, andar ka pressure zyada ho to phailta hai, dono barabar hon to sitara mustahkam (stable) hai.

blocks.title: Example 13.3
blocks.problem: Ek sitare ka mass 2 × 10³⁰ kg aur radius 7 × 10⁸ m hai. Gravitational pressure nikalein aur andar ke pressure 1.0 × 10¹⁴ Pa se muqabla karein.
steps: Pg = (6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²)(2 × 10³⁰ kg)²/(7 × 10⁸ m)⁴
Pg andar ke pressure (1.0 × 10¹⁴ Pa) ka taqreeban 11 guna hai.
blocks.answer: Gravity zyada taqatwar hai, is liye sitara tawazun (equilibrium) mein nahi: yeh sukrega.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Example 13.3 mein 6.67 × 4 × 10⁴⁹/2.401 × 10³⁵ ko ≈ 1.3 × 10¹⁴ Pa chhapti hai aur kehti hai ke dono pressures barabar hain, is liye sitara stable equilibrium mein hai. Sahi taqseem ≈ 1.1 × 10¹⁵ Pa deti hai, andar ke pressure ka taqreeban 11 guna; is liye gravity jeetti hai aur sitara sukarta hai.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Neutron star itna ghana hai ke us ke maddah ke ek chamche (teaspoon) ka mass 5.5 × 10¹² kg se zyada hoga, yani Giza ke Bare Ahram (Great Pyramid) ke mass ka taqreeban 900 guna. Agar poori zameen ko neutron star ki density tak daba diya jaye to woh sirf 305 m diameter ke gole mein sama jaye.

blocks.title: Example 13.4
blocks.problem: Ek bhari sitare ka mass 4 × 10³⁰ kg, radius 5 × 10⁸ m aur andar ka pressure 1 × 10¹⁴ Pa hai. Check karein ke sitara stable hai ya nahi.
blocks.answer: Gravity bohat zyada taqatwar hai, is liye sitara sukrega aur aakhir gir (collapse) sakta hai (shayad neutron star ya black hole ban jaye).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Example 13.4 mein jawab ≈ 1.7 × 10¹⁵ Pa chhapti hai; diye gaye adad ≈ 1.7 × 10¹⁶ Pa dete hain. Nateeja wahi hai: gravity zyada hai, sitara sukrega.

blocks.title: Example 13.5
blocks.problem: Ek sitare ka mass 1 × 10³⁰ kg, radius 1 × 10⁹ m aur andar ka pressure 5 × 10¹⁴ Pa hai. Sitare ki halat batayein.
steps: Andar ka pressure 5 × 10¹⁴ Pa, Pg se taqreeban 7.5 guna zyada hai.
blocks.answer: Andar ka pressure ghalib hai, is liye sitara phailega aur red giant ban sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Pg ≈ GM²/R⁴ istemal karte hue samjhayein ke jis sitare ka andar ka pressure Pg se kam ho woh kyun sukarta hai.
blocks.explanation: Gravity sitare ko taqreeban Pg ke pressure se andar kheenchti hai. Agar bahar dhakelne wala gas ka pressure is se kam ho to kul force andar ki taraf hai, is liye sitara sukarta hai. Sukarte hue gas dabti aur garam hoti hai, pressure barhta hai, yahan tak ke tawazun wapas aa jaye ya core gir jaye.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Sitare nebulae se bante hain; stable sitare mein gravity aur pressure barabar: ΔP/Δr = −GM_rρ_r/r².
H se He ka fusion sitare ko chalata hai; phir red giant, aur aakhir white dwarf (kam mass) ya supernova se neutron star/black hole (zyada mass).
Bhari sitare sab se kam, red dwarfs sab se zyada jeete hain.
Sooraj: 4.6 arab saal purana, abhi main sequence mein.
Pg ≈ GM²/R⁴ ko andar ke pressure se mila kar sitare ka anjam: Pg zyada to sukarna, kam to phailna.
